name: Shattered Complexes Are Unrestricted on Daisy Cubes
statement: Every finite simplicial complex $\Gamma\subseteq2^{[n]}$ containing the empty set is the shattered-set complex of a daisy cube. Consequently, no invariant that factors only through $\operatorname{Sh}(C)$ can characterize, among ample classes, a proper subclass containing every daisy cube.
proof: Regard $D=\Gamma$ itself as a down-closed concept class. Every $S\in\Gamma$ is shattered because all its subsets lie in $D$, while a shattered $S$ is contained in some $T\in D$ and hence lies in $\Gamma$ by downward closure. Thus $\operatorname{Sh}(D)=\Gamma$ and $|D|=|\operatorname{Sh}(D)|$, so $D$ is ample and daisy. For any ample class outside a proposed proper subclass, the daisy $\operatorname{Sh}(C)$ lies inside the subclass and has identical shattered-set data.
comments: In particular, the canonical Artinian reduction determined by the shattered complex cannot detect dismantlability. This does not limit the full labelled Yang ring or its fully signed resolution.
